ops.title: hermes-agent OCI image builds (2.9 GiB); n2c export broken by skopeo go.podman.io rename; path:-flake guest-build disk gotcha
ops.body:
Phase 2a: the container-native hermes-agent OCI image BUILDS clean on the hermes guest (2026-07-16). `pkgs/hermes-agent-image/image.nix` (nix2container) + `entrypoint.sh` + flake.nix nix2container input. Store path (guest) `/nix/store/3wxdhndqvlwz3advn3rs68vppfcb81n7-image-hermes-agent.json`, 2.9 GiB uncompressed single layer (big because the agent's browser toolset drags X/wayland/gstreamer/pango). Config sanity confirmed: User=0, Cmd=[tini,-g,--,bash,/entrypoint.sh], Env has HERMES_STATIC_ENV + HERMES_CONFIG_JSON derived from the SAME evaluated `services.hermes-agent` the VM uses (zero drift). flake.lock synced to host (nix2container rev 76be9608). Fork #1 non-issue: repo nixpkgs 25.05 == locked 6201e203 == the proven spike rev; n2c built clean against it. Build did NOT harm the running agent (PID stable, no OOM, 8G swap active, disk stayed >18.6G).

**GOTCHA 1 — nix2container OCI export is BROKEN with nixpkgs 6201e203.** n2c's export helpers (copyTo/copyToDockerDaemon/`skopeo copy nix:`) build a patched `skopeo-nix2container`, which FAILS: skopeo 1.18.0 renamed its vendored image lib to `vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5`, but n2c's patch still `cd vendor/github.com/containers/image/v5`. n2c 76be9608 IS upstream HEAD (no fix). So the spike's documented `skopeo copy nix:` export was never actually run with these pins. The IMAGE builds fine (needs no skopeo); only export tooling is broken. FIX options: switch image.nix to `pkgs.dockerTools.streamLayeredImage` (produces a `container image load`-able tar, NO skopeo — PREFERRED, drops the n2c dependency), OR patch n2c's skopeo patch to target `go.podman.io/image/v5`, OR pin an older skopeo (pre-rename) for skopeo-nix2container only. Deferred: export isn't on the critical path — the egress prototype uses a minimal container, and the image rebuilds anyway for the real-tun entrypoint switch ([[apple/container real-tun works with --cap-add NET_ADMIN (resolves userspace-tailscale reachability)]]); resolve export at that rebuild.

**GOTCHA 2 — path:-flake guest builds copy the whole working tree into the nix store.** A `path:` flake copies the entire dir — `.build` (~6.5G) + `result-hermes` (~6.4G) blew the guest disk to 0 on first copy. When shipping the repo tree to the guest for a build, EXCLUDE `.build result* .venv .jj .git .pytest_cache .ruff_cache dist` (tar with --exclude). Reclaimed immediately, agent unharmed.

**GOTCHA 3 (fixed) — nix2container /etc layer collision.** Both `buildEnv` and the custom `rootfs` runCommand contributed `/etc` with different modes → n2c layer builder rejects the collision. FIXED in image.nix with `pathsToLink = [ "/bin" ]` on the buildEnv. Guest build (`/root/hermes-build`) intact.

Host container tooling confirmed present: apple/container 1.1.0 CAN `container image load` an OCI archive once export is unblocked (the build agent's "host has no runtime" referred to the GUEST, which correctly has no apple/container).
